title: Chiến lược sáng tạo trong truyền thông

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply concepts of communication strategy, message creation, and creative messaging.
Develop and implement marketing communication strategies for products/services.
Generate and evaluate creative ideas for communication messages.
Design and select elements for effective communication messages.
Apply principles of public relations in communication strategy.
Analyze and solve problems related to communication strategy.
Collaborate effectively in group projects and presentations.
Prepare and deliver effective presentations on communication strategies.
Conduct research and analyze data for communication strategies.
Write clear and persuasive communication messages and reports.
